description: Items 3-8: scoped public-source-audit record (tool has only --project-root, so use a read-only mirror of the touched files and report a proposal), record the four approved business behaviours (+ ~900 px dock yield) in the Vietnamese workspace-contract skill and sync the installed copy, state BLOCKED_DEPENDENCY with the exact follow-up for OM9-L2-01-02/03, confirm no QymCAD code or build dependency, explain why planning_state is unchanged, and reconcile docs/openmatrix9-progress.json, the validation doc and final-report-vi.md with a done / human-only table. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 for the file list and numbers.
steps: Item 3: run `python tools\public_source_audit.py` at h:\OpenMatrix9, record exact command, exit code, error count and grouped first path segments (expect exit 1, ~11721, all in private trees). Create build\scoped-audit\<date>-l3-002\ and COPY (never move) Resources\ plus the L3-002 touched files (om9-app src/workbench_regions.rs, src/ui.rs, src/ui/chrome.rs, src/lib.rs, tests/workbench_regions.rs, tests/status_bar_overlap.rs, tests/workbench_regions_sizes.rs, tools/validate_m01_l3_002_ui_matrix.py, implementation/{design,fixtures,evidence}/M01/OM9-L3-01-01-002/*, the validation doc, docs/openmatrix9-progress.json, the skill SKILL.md, .agents/tasks/m01-l3-002-docking/*.md|*.json); no PNGs, nothing from private trees. Run `python tools\public_source_audit.py --project-root build\scoped-audit\<date>-l3-002`; then add control.exe and control.png to the mirror only, expect exit 1 with exactly those, delete them, re-run to exit 0. Save all runs to implementation/evidence/M01/OM9-L3-01-01-002/closeout-03.scoped-audit.log. Do NOT edit tools/public_source_audit.py. Write the proposal (--paths or --only-tracked via git ls-files, optional --exclude list, default behaviour unchanged, trade-off) for the user to decide. Never write that the full audit passed.

Item 4: edit skills/openmatrix9-workspace-contract/SKILL.md (Vietnamese). Insert after the section 'Mặc định giao diện khi khởi động OpenMatrix9' a section '## Vùng workbench docking (OM9-L3-01-01-002)' with a dated consent line (date from Get-Date; quoting the user's reply 'làm xong các việc chưa xong cho xong M01 L2-01-01 L3-002' as consent to the proposed text in final-report-vi.md) and bullets: rail trái, bốn viewport và ô nhập lệnh luôn được giữ; dock phải nhường khi cửa sổ hẹp hơn khoảng 900 px; (a) dưới mức tối thiểu 560x286 (320x286 không rail trái) hiện lỗi 'Layout:' và giữ kế hoạch tốt gần nhất, không kẹp âm thầm; (b) dòng lệnh không thể bị mất bằng cách ẩn, vẫn được giữ chỗ với thông báo CommandInputKept; (c) khi đang có lỗi vùng, đồng bộ kích thước panel và kẹp menu nổi không ghi lại layout; (d) dock phải nhường / rail trái thu hẹp được ghi vào lịch sử CMD và vào thanh trạng thái nếu không có lỗi đang hiện; plus one scope sentence (không phải nghiệm thu docking/persistence/M01-UI đầy đủ). Add nothing else. Then Copy-Item that single file over C:\Users\nguye\.codex\skills\openmatrix9-workspace-contract\SKILL.md and compare Get-FileHash of both; record that the sync requirement was met.

Item 5: in docs/validation/2026-10-16-m01-l3-002-workbench-docking-regions.md, docs/openmatrix9-progress.json entry m01-l3-01-01-002-..., and final-report-vi.md state that OM9-L2-01-02 and OM9-L2-01-03 are out of scope, stubs kept (CommandInputHost, ViewportSceneHost, AttachedCmdFrame::command_input_ready always true), status BLOCKED_DEPENDENCY, follow-up: 'when OM9-L2-01-02 lands replace the constant-true AttachedCmdFrame::command_input_ready adapter in ui.rs with the real CMD host query and add a frame test where the host is not ready so RegionError::CommandInputUnavailable is exercised; when OM9-L2-01-03 lands replace the Workspace impl of ViewportSceneHost and re-run tests/workbench_regions.rs'. Read the AttachedCmdFrame doc comment in ui.rs first; add one sentence only if the follow-up is missing; no logic change.

Item 6: record, with exact commands and outputs, that no QymCAD build dependency exists: `cargo tree --workspace` filtered for qymcad (no match), Select-String of standalone Cargo.toml files for qymcad (no match), list of qymcad mentions in standalone/crates/**/*.rs (doc comments only), `git -C vendor-research/QymCAD rev-parse HEAD` equals 746a17f1... and `status --porcelain` empty. Keep legal_reuse_status PENDING_HUMAN_M00_APPROVAL everywhere; state it is a human decision.

Item 7: re-run a read-only count of planning_state values in l3.json / l4.json / L2.json under OM9_Milestones and read execution_policy of one L3-002 l4.json; record the vocabulary. Decision: leave L3-002 l3.json SPEC_ONLY_NOT_IMPLEMENTED and the four l4.json NOT_STARTED; explain (no implemented-but-gated value in the convention, only tools/merge_l4_overlay.py writes it and only between two not-implemented values, declared preconditions M00/legal/dependencies are not met, protected tree). Do not edit anything under OM9_Milestones. Confirm with git status scoped to the L3-002 folder that this task changed nothing there.

Item 8: after reading the final cargo and runner outputs, update docs/openmatrix9-progress.json (entry m01-l3-01-01-002-...: add `closeout` with date, per-item status and evidence paths; update not_yet_done, behaviour_changes_pending_consent -> recorded with date, next_action; keep valid JSON, keep history), docs/validation/2026-10-16-m01-l3-002-workbench-docking-regions.md (add Close-out section in English with the done / human-only table and commands), .agents/tasks/m01-l3-002-docking/verification.md (append close-out), and .agents/tasks/m01-l3-002-docking/final-report-vi.md (Vietnamese: update 'Chưa được xác minh' and 'Thay đổi quy tắc nghiệp vụ', add the table Việc / Trạng thái / Ai đóng with rows: status-bar fix; simulated size+150% matrix; real DPI/second monitor/live drag (người); public audit (scoped exit 0, full exit 1, người quyết định); skill recorded and synced; L2-01-02/03 BLOCKED_DEPENDENCY; legal/M00 PENDING_HUMAN_M00_APPROVAL; planning_state unchanged with explanation). Exact next actions for the user in order: (1) run the shortened M01-UI manual checklist and sign OM9-L4-01-01-002-05.ui-review.json, (2) decide M00 legal approval of QymCAD reuse, (3) decide the audit scoping proposal; then next sibling L3-003 (live drag preview). Use real numbers from the final runs.

Clean up: delete scoped-audit control files, leave no temp files outside build\; confirm `git diff --cached --name-only` is empty and report that nothing was committed. Run final cargo fmt/check/clippy/test --workspace once and record the outputs in verification.md.
